question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
customer_monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        total_deposits - total_withdrawals as month_end_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
),
monthly_positive_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) as positive_balance_count
    FROM customer_monthly_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month
),
monthly_avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        mpc.month,
        mpc.positive_balance_count,
        mab.avg_balance
    FROM monthly_positive_counts mpc
    JOIN monthly_avg_balances mab ON mpc.month = mab.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_balance_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_count DESC) as rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_balance_count ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM combined
),
top_month AS (
    SELECT month, avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_desc = 1
),
bottom_month AS (
    SELECT month, avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE rank_asc = 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM top_month) as highest_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM bottom_month) as lowest_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM top_month) - (SELECT avg_balance FROM bottom_month) as difference
